summary: Wrote a 9-phase, 16-hour implementation plan for the Move 5 three-channel orchestration conclusion stage, carrying forward research's Resolution B verdict on the 184 reconciliation and its issues.jsonl-is-the-sole-carrier finding. Key planning decisions: the executable stage body and derivation contract go in a new context/contracts/conclusion-stage.md (pointed to from SKILL.md) because verify-deploy gate 9's postflight-boundary lint would otherwise flag an inline Move 5 body; a new orchestrate-conclusion-aggregate.sh carries the mechanical aggregation plus a per-channel approval ledger, making the no-cross-firing invariant mechanically testable; the roadmap update invokes --regenerate only. Phase 1 corrects and widens file_scope from 10 to 19 entries first, because the declared scope names a quarantined roadmap script and omits manifest.json, whose provides.scripts is file-granular.

artifacts.summary: 9-phase plan across 6 dependency waves for the Move 5 conclusion stage: footprint correction, derivation contract, aggregator script and suite, mandatory upstream contribution, boundary and commit-contract table, stage body, architecture docs, and cross-cutting fixtures.
